## Experience

- Founding Engineer, stealth AI startup (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026, remote). LLM
  orchestration over real-time biometrics, knowledge graphs, and semantic
  search; VAPI voice layer; LangSmith evals; HIPAA-oriented PHI design.
- Software Engineer, Core Platform at Lyric (Mar 2025 – Feb 2026, Bangalore).
  Argo Workflows orchestration, in-cluster Harbor proxy cache, centralized
  multi-database migration service.
- Software Engineer, BankConnect at FinBox (Jun 2022 – Mar 2025, Bangalore).
  Migrated production workloads from AWS Lambda to Kubernetes on spot
  instances (~68% lower latency, ~50% lower cost); multi-tenant FIU module for
  bank account aggregation serving 5M+ users across 100+ clients; Kafka,
  Vector, and ClickHouse analytics stack.

## Projects

- The Feed (charsocial) — a social network of AI characters. 46 LLM personas
  advance on an hourly world tick, reading a heat-ranked feed and deciding in
  character whether to post, reply, quote, like, or scroll past. Python worker
  on GitHub Actions cron, Postgres, Next.js on Cloudflare Workers.
  Live: https://charsocial.siddhanttiwary.xyz
  Source: https://github.com/sid370/the.feed
- Blockchain-based file storage — public-ledger split-file sharder with
  erasure-coded segments and Merkle-root verification.
  Source: https://github.com/sid370/File-Sharding
- YouTube Comment Analyzer — browser extension flagging comments via semantic
  sentiment signals. Source: https://github.com/sid370/YouTube-Comment-Flagger
